list.title: My quotes
list.blurb: What you asked for, what has an answer, and what is still on the clock.
list.emptyTitle: You haven't asked for a quote yet
list.emptyText: On services marked "by quote", tell the provider what you need and they answer with a price and a date.

request.title: Ask for a quote
request.lead: The more you tell them, the more accurate the price. {{provider}} reads this and answers with an amount, a date, and the duration.
request.descriptionPlaceholder: Tell us what you need: what it is, how many, where, and what you already have.
request.descriptionHint: No phone numbers or emails: the conversation stays on Ntizo until the booking is paid.
request.photosHint: up to 5 · JPEG, PNG, WebP, or PDF · 10 MB each
request.addressNote: The provider sees the neighborhood and the city. The exact street only appears once the booking is confirmed.
request.railPromise: They commit to answering within {{hours}} hours. If they don't, the request expires and we'll let you know.
request.step1Body: Price, date, time, and duration, with a note from the provider.
request.step2Body: No obligation. You can chat before deciding.
request.step3Body: Only when you accept. The booking is confirmed once the payment lands.
request.railFooter: Ntizo adds nothing on top: the proposal's amount is what you pay.
request.errorDescriptionRequired: Write what you need before sending.
request.errorContact: Take the phone number or email out of the text. The conversation stays on Ntizo until the booking is paid.
request.errorAlreadyOpen: You already have an open quote for this service.
request.errorNotQuotable: This service no longer accepts quote requests.
request.errorGeneric: The request couldn't be sent. Try again.

detail.notFoundBody: It may have been withdrawn, or the address is wrong.
detail.waitingBody: {{provider}} has until {{when}} to answer. We'll let you know as soon as there's a response.
detail.stepPaymentBody: once you accept, you get the request on your phone
detail.railFooter: Accepting creates the booking and sends the M-Pesa request. You have 15 minutes to confirm it on your phone; if you don't, the slot is released and the provider is notified.
detail.movedOn: This quote changed in the meantime. We reloaded it.

accept.title: Accept the proposal
accept.lead: Nothing is charged without your PIN. When you accept, you get an M-Pesa request on your phone and have 15 minutes to confirm it.
accept.phoneLead: You'll get the payment request at
accept.phoneHint: It has to be an active M-Pesa number, with enough balance for {{amount}}.
accept.phoneRequired: Write the number that gets the M-Pesa request.
accept.phoneNotVodacom: M-Pesa only works on Vodacom numbers (84 or 85).
accept.next1Body: The slot is reserved for you right away.
accept.next2Body: Within the next minute, on the number above. Enter your PIN.
accept.next3Body: The provider is notified and sees your full address.
accept.nextFooter: If the request doesn't arrive, you can ask for it again from the booking with "Pay now". After 15 minutes without payment, the slot is released and the provider is notified.
accept.slotTakenTitle: That time is no longer free
accept.slotTakenBody: We've asked {{provider}} for a new proposal. We'll let you know as soon as there's a response.
accept.errorLapsed: This proposal has lapsed. Ask the provider for a new one.
accept.errorMoved: This quote changed in the meantime. Reopen it to see what changed.
accept.errorGeneric: The proposal couldn't be accepted. Try again.

close.rejectBody: {{provider}} will know right away, with the reason. You can add a note or a file if it helps explain.
close.withdrawBody: {{provider}} will know you no longer need it. You can add a note if you'd like to explain.
close.declineBody: {{customer}} will know right away, with the reason. You can add a note or a file if it helps explain.

reason.wrong_time: The date doesn't work for me
reason.found_elsewhere: I've already sorted it another way

close.errorMoved: This changed in the meantime. We reloaded it.
close.errorContact: Take the phone number or email out of the note.
close.errorGeneric: This couldn't be completed. Try again.

provider.title: Quotes
provider.blurb: {{count}} awaiting your answer · the most urgent expires in {{left}}
provider.emptyText: Mark a service as "by quote" and requests will show up here.
provider.notFoundBody: It may have been withdrawn, or it doesn't belong to this space.
provider.whereNote: The exact street appears once the booking is confirmed
provider.responseWindow: Response window of {{hours}} h, set on the service.
provider.movedOn: This request changed in the meantime. We reloaded it.

propose.title: Your proposal
propose.notePlaceholder: What's included, what's not, what to sort out on site.
propose.attachmentsHint: PDF quote, photos of similar jobs
propose.validityNote: The proposal stays valid for {{hours}} hours. You can revise it while the customer hasn't decided; the previous one stays in the history.
propose.errorPriceBelowMinimum: The price is below the platform minimum.
propose.errorStartsInPast: Choose a date in the future.
propose.errorDurationInvalid: The duration has to be between 1 minute and 24 hours.
propose.errorMemberCannotPerform: This person doesn't do this service.
propose.errorSlotOverlap: That time clashes with another booking for this person.
propose.errorContact: Take the phone number or email out of the note.
propose.errorMoved: This request changed in the meantime. We reloaded it.
propose.errorGeneric: The proposal couldn't be sent. Try again.

entry.panelBody: The price depends on the job. Tell us what you need and {{provider}} answers with an amount, a date, and the duration, with no obligation on your part.
